description: Test class for ModuleClassLoader, containing unit tests to verify resource inclusion logic based on module versions, file paths, and glob pattern matching within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ModuleClassLoaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ModuleClassLoader, verifying resource inclusion rules, glob pattern matching, and platform version handling.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach to initialize mock modules and resources before each test.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndOpenmrsVersionMatches
methods.description: Test for resource inclusion when file matches path and OpenMRS platform version matches the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesButOpenmrsVersionDoesNot
methods.description: Test for resource exclusion when file matches but OpenMRS platform version does not match the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileDoesNotMatchAndOpenmrsVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test for resource inclusion when file does not match the path, regardless of OpenMRS version.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndModuleVersionMatches
methods.description: Test for resource inclusion when module version matches the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndModuleIsMissing
methods.description: Test when module information is missing; resource should be included.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleIsNotMissing
methods.description: Test when module exists and versions do not match; resource should be excluded.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test when specific module version ranges do not match with the started modules.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndOpenmrsVersionMatchesButModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test when file matches platform version but module version does not match the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleNotFound
methods.description: Test when the referenced module is not present in started modules; resource should be excluded.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileDoesNotMatchAndModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test for inclusion when file path does not match but version conditions are met (or ignored).

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeWhenVersionWildcardMatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test confirming glob pattern matching with wildcards results in inclusion/exclusion as intended.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldIncludeMatchingPlatformVersionsUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test confirming glob pattern matching for platform version matches.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeModuleWhenVersionsMatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test that glob pattern matching excludes files when module version ranges do not align.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeWhenPlatformVersionsMisnmatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test that glob matching respects platform version mismatches and excludes resources.

methods.name: testGlobPatternMatches
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that file paths match glob patterns intended for resource filtering.

methods.name: testGlobPatternDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that non-matching file paths are correctly excluded by glob patterns.

methods.name: testIsMatchingConditionalResourceWithNullConfigVersionDoesNotThrow
methods.description: Test to ensure glob matching logic does not throw exceptions when configuration versions are null.
